## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Entity

**Brand Name:** QuickKitAI / Raja AI Systems  
**Entity Type:** Managed Autonomous AI Agency & Business Automation Platform  
**Primary Focus:** High-ticket real estate developers, builders, and brokers in India, with healthcare workflow automation as a secondary specialized service.  
**Core Value Proposition:** Deploying a five-member autonomous AI workforce operating 24/7 across WhatsApp, CRM, and voice channels to deliver sub-12-second speed-to-lead qualification, appointment setting, site-visit confirmations, and reputation management.

---

## 2. The Five-Member Autonomous Workforce Architecture

### 2.1 Agent 1: 12-Second WhatsApp Speed-to-Lead Closer
- **Role:** Immediate inbound lead intake, qualification, and appointment booking.
- **Channels:** WhatsApp Business API, voice-note synthesis, SMS, and interactive web chat.
- **Workflow:** Ingests inbound ads (Meta Ads, Google Ads, 99acres, MagicBricks), responds within 12 seconds, verifies budget, timeline, and location preference, and locks the appointment.

### 2.2 Agent 2: Apify B2B Lead Prospector & Intelligence Agent
- **Role:** Targeted prospect research, competitive intelligence, and high-value account enrichment.
- **Safeguards:** Rate-limited to a maximum of 50 enriched executive dossiers per day to maintain deliverability and compliance.

### 2.3 Agent 3: CRM Sentinel & No-Show Guard
- **Role:** Calendar locking, pipeline synchronization, pre-visit location reminders, and transportation coordination.
- **Outcome:** Eliminates no-shows for physical site visits and in-clinic consultations.

### 2.4 Agent 4: Dead Lead Reviver
- **Role:** Conversational reactivation of dormant CRM databases.
- **Strategy:** Short, personalized conversational check-ins to re-engage past leads without spam triggers.

### 2.5 Agent 5: 5-Star Reputation & Local SEO Sentinel
- **Role:** Post-visit feedback collection, Google Business Profile review routing, and escalation of dissatisfied customer feedback to senior management.

---

## 3. Supported Integrations & Ecosystem

- **Communication Channels:** WhatsApp Business API, Twilio, SendGrid SMTP/IMAP, Webhooks.
- **CRMs & Lead Systems:** Odoo CRM, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Google Sheets.
- **Scheduling Engines:** Google Calendar, Cal.com, Microsoft Outlook.
- **Infrastructure:** Private VPS container environments, SSL/TLS 1.3 encryption, AES-256 data security.

---

## 4. Published Service Plans & Pricing

- **AI Visibility Audit:** ₹9,999 one-time (comprehensive multi-platform baseline audit across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Overviews).
- **AI Visibility Monitor:** ₹29,999/month (fortnightly prompt tracking and citation monitoring).
- **Managed Real Estate AI Workforce (Growth):** ₹75,000 setup + ₹1,20,000/month retainer (includes inbound qualification, WhatsApp speed-to-lead, calendar booking, CRM handoff).
- **Dussehra Pilot Offer (Limited Cohort):** ₹35,000 upfront setup + ₹1,20,000/month management with a 10-site-visit performance SLA.
- **Enterprise Multi-Location Deployment:** ₹2,50,000 setup + ₹2,00,000/month retainer (custom multi-branch orchestration).
